proposals.Title: V8 Upgrade
proposals.Summary:
## Upgraded Cosmos SDK to 0.50 and IBC to v8

## Extended Burner module
- Burner can now burn factory tokens
- IBC coins are exchanged to BZE if they have a liquidity pool with enough liquidity, and the resulting BZE is burned
- Liquidity pool shares are locked in the blackhole address

## Extended Tradebin module
- Added liquidity pools using the constant product formula
- Granted the minter role to the Tradebin module for LP share minting

## Added TX Fee Collector module
- Allows users to pay transaction fees in any denomination that has a liquidity pool with BZE
- Exchanges fees collected in other denominations to BZE and distributes them to delegators

## Rewards module
- Migrated 75,000 BZE (75000000000 ubze) from the Rewards module account to the Community Pool. This amount was accumulated during the creation of three staking rewards and, due to a bug, was never sent to the Community Pool as intended.

## Removed module
- Removed the unused Scavenge module
